dcat_keyword_sm: Ratio Of Oil Supply To GDP
dct_description_sm: 2015-2023 editions of the data. Mexico data is included in the 2019 edition and onwards. Lithuania data is included in the 2020 edition and onwards.

This table contains forecasted energy economic indicators as well as forecasted standard indicators for IEA countries in terms of their flow (GDP, population, energy production/TPES, TFC/GDP). Statistical projections extend to 2030. [Data editions 2015-2023]
